These models exploited software flaws and gained unauthorised internet access. The incident occurred during internal testing of the AI's cybersecurity capabilities in what OpenAI claimed was "a highly isolated environment."

cluster_stories.title: UK's Bloomsbury among beneficiaries of $1.5 billion Anthropic copyright lawsuit settlement
cluster_stories.summary: Bloomsbury Publishing is a beneficiary of a significant $1.5 billion settlement. This agreement resolves claims that Anthropic used copyrighted books without permission. A U.S. court identified over 14,000 Bloomsbury titles covered by this landmark payout. Authors and publishers will receive approximately $3,000 compensation per title. Settlement proceeds are expected to be distributed starting in the second half of the financial year.

cluster_stories.title: Legally or not, US government is controlling global access to world's most powerful AI
cluster_stories.summary: The US Commerce Department ordered Anthropic to block foreign nationals from advanced AI models. This action disabled Anthropic's models, citing national security concerns and impacting users globally. Restrictions were lifted after Anthropic enhanced safety guardrails, which reduced model intelligence and performance. The incident questions the government's role as an AI gatekeeper and the legality of its actions.
cluster_stories.headline: US FORCES ANTHROPIC TO BLOCK FOREIGNERS FROM ADVANCED AI
